lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in identifiable vertical columns, with approximately five columns present in the region posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the primary blobs, creating a discernible grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical transition from light pixels above to shadowed pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller diameter spots compared to the organized, grid-like pattern of the trunk.
